name: PER_MANAGER_HRCHY_DN
description: This table stores the flattened manager hierarchy details. The denormalized details are derived from the supervisors tables and stored in this table.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: IMMEDIATE_REPORTEE_ASG_ID
columns.description: IMMEDIATE_REPORTEE_ASG_ID column is for internal use in PL/SQL procedure calls. It will not be exposed in the view or entity objects.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to PER_PERSONS table.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M table.

columns.name: PRIMARY_ASSIGNMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Identifies whether the assignment is the primary

columns.name: MANAGER_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to Per Persons. Identifies the Person record

columns.name: MANAGER_ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Foregin Key to Per Assignments. Identifies the manager's assignment

columns.name: MANAGER_LEVEL
columns.description: Not supported

columns.name: PRIMARY_MANAGER_FLAG
columns.description: Set to Y if manager type = LINE_MANAGER. Automatically generated

columns.name: MANAGER_TYPE
columns.description: Determines the type of manager: line manager, project manager, etc

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.
